findings: The book says Cd2+ replaces Ca2+ because of 'higher charge density'; both are 2+ ions of very similar radius. Clarified in a note.
The book calls pesticides 'such as DDT and Glyphosate' non-polar and insoluble in water; glyphosate is polar and water-soluble. Noted in a warning; flagged for review.

Figure 33.2 does not link each effect to a substance; the redrawn figure says so. Table 33.2 is carried as a table. The Quick Check questions are printed without answers; the lesson's answers were derived for it and need the second-person review.

Owner rule (2026-10-21): the English lesson carries only the book's content.
